meta.title: The project title is required to publish
gaps: The draft_event recipe creates a project with a default title; there is no vocabulary element to create a draft without a title, so the missing‑title condition cannot be expressed directly.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: The project title is required to publish

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)
